description.zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，保证在不同请求间唯一，大小写敏感、不超过64个ASCII字符。
description.en: A client-generated, case-sensitive token that you can use to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique among different requests and can be up to 64 ASCII characters in length.

description.zh:
账号的新密码，需符合如下要求：
* 至少包含大写字母、小写字母、数字或特殊字符中的任意三种。
* 长度为8~32个字符。
* 特殊字符为`!@#$%^&*()_+-=`。
description.en:
The new password for the account. The password must meet the following requirements:

- Contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.

- Be 8 to 32 characters in length.

- The special characters are `!@#$%^&*()_+-=`.

title.zh: 修改边缘集群账号密码

example.unifiedCli: aliyun polardb modify-account-password-zonal --db-cluster-id pc-00000000000000 --account-name testacc --new-account-password Pw123456 --password-type Tair --client-token 6000170000591aed949d0f500000000000000000000 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun polardb ModifyAccountPasswordZonal --region cn-hangzhou --NewAccountPassword Pw123456 --DBClusterId 'pc-00000000000000' --ClientToken 6000170000591aed949d0f500000000000000000000 --PasswordType Tair --AccountName testacc
